name: Abi
summary: A companion robot for aged-care residents and children in hospitals, built by Grace Brown's Melbourne startup with body-language advice from Pixar and DreamWorks animators — the design goal is warmth, not capability. It recognizes faces, remembers past conversations, tells stories and jokes, plays music and games, does tai chi and blows bubbles.
notable: Character and body language designed with Pixar and DreamWorks animators
Deployed in Australian aged care, expanding to the US

sources.title: How Andromeda Robotics' AI-powered robot Abi is combating loneliness — MassRobotics
